newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DANE SORENSEN NAMED MANAGER OF WALSALL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DANE SORENSEN NAMED MANAGER OF WALSALL.

text.p: Former Danish international Jan Sorensen was named as the new manager of English second division club Walsall on Wednesday.
The 42-year-old Dane, whose playing career included spells at Dutch rivals Ajax and Feyenoord, played for Bruges in the 1978 European Cup final against Liverpool.
Although he has been out of football for about eight years, Sorensen said he hopes to take the club into the first division by the end of his two-year contract.
Sorensen, who lives in the midlands near Walsall, is married to an English woman, and takes over from Chris Nicholl who resigned at the end of last season.
